description: Buy everything in your cart. `value` must be at least the cart total (see geode_market_view_my_cart). Digital products and services are delivered, and the seller paid, immediately; physical products wait for the seller to ship and deliver. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

confirm_token.description: Token from the first call, to confirm this irreversible action

deliver_to_address.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

value.description: GEODE to send with this call (explicit; never inferred)

name: geode_market_checkout_cart
title: Market: checkout cart
